summary: Iteration 13 retest of the 2 HIGH bugs from iteration_12, the minor fixes, and the main flow. Both HIGH bugs are FIXED. Regression: test_billing_packet_http.py and test_finalization.py 21/21 passed. New file test_billing_fixes_http.py 8/8 passed. Bug 1 (Send guard): Send on a completed packet-billed load returns 400 with 'Completion & billing'. GET /invoices sets packet_billed=true. The Invoices page shows invoice-bill-via-load-<id> and no invoice-send-*. The load page shows no load-send-invoice-* on a completed packet load. Early pickup Send with a confirmed destination returns 200 and goes to ap@example.test. An unconfirmed destination returns 400. Bug 2 (corrections): after Adjust times, the correction_pending blocker is present, /billing/submit returns 400, and billing-submit-button is hidden in the UI. pending-adjustment-DC-xxxx is shown with Issue correction. An empty reason returns 400. The supplement -A1 is ready at exactly the difference (37.5). Without a reload, blockers are [] and the state is revision_review with no stale '(simulated)'. 'Issue revised packet & submit' gives v2 issued and v1 superseded, and the v1 PDF bytes are unchanged. v2 totals: invoiced = detention_calculated = 225, with A1 listed as 'New - submitted with this packet'. A decrease creates a credit_note (-A2). Credit note then v2 gives correct packet totals (112.5). Minor fixes verified: a None->'' no-op PUT keeps confirmed_at (a real AP change still drops it); the timeline shows 'Document uploaded'; the drawer shows 'Upcoming due date · day 27 / Past due · day 31 / 37 / Final notice · day 51'. The signature message is only for need_sig docs (code review). Demo fleet unchanged: EVG-77421 accepted, APX-30277 blocked [document], APX-30188 failed, RL-55102 awaiting_portal, EVG-77510 not_needed. Found 2 new minor issues.

minor.issue: Credit notes do not reduce outstanding. Repro: submitted load 187.5, delivery departure -60 min, Issue correction gives DC-xxxx-A1 credit_note 75 (status 'credit'), revised packet v2 has totals invoiced/outstanding 112.5. But completion.payment.outstanding is still 187.5, so the panel PAYMENT chip and probably the Invoices 'Waiting on brokers' total are overstated. Subtract credit notes (adjusts_invoice_id) from their original's balance.

Still requires broker.email ('Add the broker's email on the load first', 400) even when the confirmed AP email destination is set, although the email goes to the AP address. Repro: confirmed load with ap_email, broker.email='' -> pickup departs -> send -> 400. Only require the broker email when there is no destination recipient.

issues: While a correction is pending, the SUBMISSION chip and the 'Final invoice submission' obligation still read 'Accepted (simulated)'. A 'Correction pending' state would be clearer.
The 'Issue correction' button has no data-testid.
The LoadDetail sendInvoice toast says 'Invoice emailed to broker' and the drawer label 'Broker' shows the AP email. Consider 'Billed to'.
The timeline still shows the raw quoted value "pod" after 'Document uploaded'.

action_items: Subtract credit notes from outstanding in completion.payment and in the invoice list totals
Allow early send without broker.email when a confirmed AP destination exists
Optional: show 'Correction pending' in the submission chip; add data-testid to the Issue correction button; fix the 'emailed to broker' and 'Broker' wording
critical_code_review_comments: finalize: ctx.pending_adjustments is a module-global passed into blockers(). It is safe today only because no await happens between set and reset. Pass it as an argument instead.
DELETE /loads is refused once any invoice is sent, so QA loads with sent invoices pile up in the QA fleet (expected, but test data grows).

success_rate.backend: 100% (29/29 pytest); 2 minor issues from edge probes

seed_data_creation: QA fleet: TEST-CORRUI (now v2 issued, has -A1), TEST-BLKUI (completed, blocked, ready invoices), plus several TEST-* loads with sent invoices that cannot be deleted. The demo fleet was not touched.
